static_selftest.scope: AST, exact hash pins, standard-library imports, disposable filesystem races, CLI negatives, fork-inherited capability, fixed leases and atomic receipt publication only

v3_blocker_remediation.S47-C2-SOURCE-BLOCKER-001_and_S47-C2-ADV: The public entry accepts exactly three unique split-form options, rejects every worker marker/equals/abbreviation/repeat/alternate path, and both parent and child bind literal execution_01.
v3_blocker_remediation.S47-C2-SOURCE-BLOCKER-002: The public CLI has no worker dispatch. The monitored parent alone forks one child; an opaque object and 256-bit secret are inherited in memory and consumed once before the raw worker gate.
v3_blocker_remediation.S47-C2-ADV-002: Bound JSON/source bytes are read through one O_NOFOLLOW regular-file descriptor, hashed and parsed/compiled from that same snapshot. The transitive S39 to S35 source-manifest reader is replaced by safe_ref_required_sources; launcher and authorization independently pin the gate SHA.
v3_blocker_remediation.S47-C2-ADV-003: Prepare, attach and authorization use fixed staging/attempt leases. A post-claim failure publishes or retains the same fixed lease and cannot select a PID/time/random retry name.
v3_blocker_remediation.S47-C2-ADV-004: The general gate has no unpublished flag. Only check_attachment_preflight accepts the fixed hidden manifest and returns the non-PASS UNPUBLISHED_ATTACHMENT_PREFLIGHT_ONLY status.
v3_blocker_remediation.S47-C2-ADV-005: The full gate carries a detached canonical manifest/output snapshot. Runtime loading uses that snapshot and a stable output dirfd, fixed O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW temp, inode checks and same-directory atomic replacement.

claim_boundary: This receipt freezes an unexecuted V4 source candidate and records two author self-tests. The fork capability claim covers the reviewed launcher and fresh external CLI/process route; it is not a sandbox against arbitrary code already executing inside the trusted parent process. Nothing here is a formal source review, core freeze, attachment, launch authorization, model load, generation, readback, score, quality result, baseline failure, method gain, novelty result, or publication result.
required_next_gate: Two new different-author V3-format source reviews must independently bind all eight exact V4 hashes and reproduce the dual-interpreter adversarial matrix. Only two PASS reviews permit the unique prepare; every later core, attach, terminal review, authorization and launch gate remains closed.
